text: GrowERP Insurance. Our answer to Tasco's AI for Insurance challenge: compulsory motor insurance in Vietnam that is easy to buy, easy to carry and easy to claim, without a single discount or price trick.

The agency works in GrowERP: policies from several insurers, motor policies with their licence plate, the renewals due in the next sixty days, claims and commissions, all in one system with the accounting.
Now the customer. She logs in on her phone, in Vietnamese. Her compulsory motor policy is a digital card: plate, validity, cover and a QR code. Nothing to lose, nothing to print.
Police or a garage scan the code and see a live check: valid or not, with a masked plate and no personal data.
What am I actually covered for? One tap, and AI explains the policy in plain Vietnamese, using only the policy's own limits and deductibles, and inventing nothing.

After an accident, a claim takes minutes. What happened, when and where, then a photo checklist: the plate, the whole car, the damage and the other vehicle. She agrees that the photos are checked with the help of AI, and that people decide.

At the agency the claim arrives complete. In the background a vision model has already triaged the photos: damaged parts, severity, whether the plate matches the policy, and what evidence is missing. It is advice for the adjuster, never a decision.
The adjuster reviews it and files the claim with the insurer.
The customer sees every step, what it means and what happens next, and gets an email on each change. No more calling to ask.
Questions at any hour go to the assistant. It answers from her own policies and claims, never quotes prices, and passes anything it cannot answer to a person.
Easy to buy, to carry and to claim. People decide, consent and minimal data by design, and ready for a four week pilot with Tasco. GrowERP, open source.
